summary: nora config — the operator's safe config mutation surface: set/get/unset/validate/path (deploy convention §4.5).
details: New `nora config` subcommands in nora/app/config_cli.py: dotted-key navigation, tomlkit read/write (comments survive — tomli_w would strip every rationale comment in a 75KB config), atomic tmp+os.replace write (M8 pattern), double validation via the daemon's own config.load() before and after the write.

set uses a type-compatibility rule: a TOML literal is honoured only when its type matches the key's current type, so an unquoted phone number stays a string (TOML would parse +852... as an int and the schema would reject it).
The CLI prints the restart command but never restarts the container; secrets never route through the config CLI (.env is their home). Mutations take effect on restart.
tomlkit added to runtime dependencies and uv.lock; 17 tests prove comment preservation, fail-closed rollback on invalid result, mode preservation, and the real parser surface.
limitations: Read-only operator control plane commands (nora groups, nora persons pending) are untouched; this adds the write surface only.
No doctrine/dreamer mutation yet — those are git-versioned source (operator decision 2026-09-08), hot-reload by merge only; the config CLI deliberately does not touch them.
